reuse.why: Builds on the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and introduces one shared isNonWorkingDay that all paths call, rather than re-implementing the holiday check per site.

duplication.why: Adds no new copies, but threads holidays separately through every pre-existing copy of the skip/move dispatch (getNextDate, getDatesInRange, getUpcomingDates' two branches, schedule-template's two ternaries) instead of consolidating them.

placement.why: The holiday/weekend definition and the moving loop live in shared/schedules.ts; servers only pass the config field.

scope.why: Only the holidays field, its parsing, the shared predicate and its threading through the date paths.

maintainability.why: The non-working-day rule is in one place, but adding the parameter required touching six call sites, and the search pads (3 + holidays.length) are ad-hoc; the next rule change will again need edits across the copies.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every weekend/holiday check goes through isNonWorkingDay or getDateWithSkippedWeekend

disguised_duplication.where: None introduced; the pre-existing parallel dispatches are only extended

one_place.where: isNonWorkingDay and getDateWithSkippedWeekend in shared/schedules.ts decide holiday treatment for getNextDate, getDatesInRange, getUpcomingDates and schedule-template
